purpose: A reviewed design for the project-first owner screens and for an opt-in automatic release that stays off until separately authorized.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign writes the designs for workstreams #11 (English project-first UI) and #13 (opt-in automatic release), each ending in small implementation slices. Design documents only; no release is authorized. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

This task writes one design document only: no change to src/, tests/, scripts/, schemas/, registry/ or campaigns/. Decide everything that is not owner-reserved; list owner-reserved questions separately, each with a recommended answer.

tasks.title: Design: project-first owner workspace, one question per screen
tasks.outcome: A reviewed design of every owner screen: what it answers, what it shows first, its one main action and its exact English wording.
tasks.goal: Write docs/design/OWNER_WORKSPACE.md for #11 (gh issue view 11 --comments; also #4 and #6), from docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 4 and the current dashboard (src/dashboard/server.mjs, owner.mjs, supervisor.mjs and public/). Produce: the navigation (Projects, Needs me, Settings; inside a project Where are we now, Start work, Review, Work, Step, Results, Cost) with, per screen, its one question, first visible content, one primary action and what stays in details; text wireflows for first run with no project, adding a GitHub project, adding a plain folder, starting work, approving, watching, a blocked step and a finished result; exact English copy for empty, disconnected, no-worker, GitHub-stale, paused, running, blocked and finished states; what today's views (Overview, Plans, Issues & PRs, Agents, Messages, Activity) become; the data each screen needs and which the supervisor already provides; 320px-first responsive and keyboard rules; the security headers, origin and CSRF checks kept. Include a blind task-oriented review protocol (Engineering Platform UX-002 pass A) run on a disposable dashboard with a synthetic store on a port other than 4318.
acceptance: Every statement about current behaviour cites file:line at the task base and is labelled observed; nothing is claimed as verified on the live host.
Every screen answers exactly one question and has at most one primary action; no primary-level text uses pipeline, fencing, lease, slots, control plane or campaign declaration.
Every listed state has exact copy that never implies that a published PR is merged, deployed or accepted, and the slices own src/dashboard/** only unless a supervisor API is named as a dependency.

The document ends with numbered implementation slices. Each slice is one reviewable PR and names: the outcome, the files it owns, the tests (synthetic, no network), the acceptance, its dependencies, and whether it waits for an owner or Engineering Platform decision.
Owner-reserved questions are listed separately, each with a recommended answer and what it unblocks; no product question the plan already settled (D1, D3, D5, D9) is asked again.
npm run check passes; the PR states it is a design only and nothing is built or deployed.

tasks.title: Design: opt-in automatic release with per-project authorization
tasks.outcome: A reviewed design for an automatic release mode that is off by default and needs its own owner authorization per project and destination.
tasks.goal: Write docs/design/AUTO_RELEASE.md for #13 (gh issue view 13 --comments), from docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 5.5, AW-001 and Engineering Platform's release rules, read with gh, read-only (docs/CONSTITUTION.md section 14, policies/RELEASE-001.json and the release authorizations in registry/projects). Design the two per-project modes (Review only by default; Auto Release off until separately authorized): the standing release authorization record (project, destination or environment, change classes, expiry, kill switch); eligibility of one exact verified revision; a separate release role that holds no implementer or verifier credentials; GitHub merge-then-deploy versus local apply with a reversible backup; a destination lock and idempotent release state; post-release checks, rollback, and a restart rule that never repeats an unknown irreversible action. Write the proposed narrow AW-001 amendment and the Engineering Platform authorization it needs as proposed text only.
acceptance: Every statement about current behaviour cites file:line at the task base and is labelled observed; nothing is claimed as verified on the live host.

Nothing in the document grants or enables a release: the AW-001 amendment and the EP authorization are proposals, and the slices that can be built switched off are marked separately from those that wait for the owner.
Every eligibility check blocks on missing or unknown evidence, and a restart after an unknown release outcome reconciles the destination instead of repeating the action.

The document ends with numbered implementation slices. Each slice is one reviewable PR and names: the outcome, the files it owns, the tests (synthetic, no network), the acceptance, its dependencies, and whether it waits for an owner or Engineering Platform decision.
Owner-reserved questions are listed separately, each with a recommended answer and what it unblocks; no product question the plan already settled (D1, D3, D5, D9) is asked again.
npm run check passes; the PR states it is a design only and nothing is built or deployed.
